scenarios.title: Send a contact message with valid data shows confirmation
steps: Click nav link 'Contact' in the 'Main' navigation
Verify h1 'Contact us' and form 'Contact' with fields 'Name', 'Email', 'Message' are visible
Fill 'Message' with 'Hello, I have a question about my order.'
expectedResults: URL is /contact and nav link 'Contact' is visually marked as the active link
After the short sending period the form is no longer shown
h1 reads 'Message sent'
Text 'Thanks Ada Lovelace, we reply within two working days.' is visible
No inline error messages are shown
testData: Message: Hello, I have a question about my order.
scenarios.rationale: Core happy path of the contact page; covers navigation, submit and the confirmation state.

scenarios.title: Submitting an empty form shows both required-field errors and sends nothing
expectedResults: Error 'Enter your name' is shown under the 'Name' field
Error 'Enter a valid email address' is shown under the 'Email' field
Both errors are visible at the same time
'Name' and 'Email' are marked invalid (aria-invalid=true)
h1 remains 'Contact us', the form is still shown and no 'Message sent' confirmation appears
Button still reads 'Send message' and is enabled
scenarios.rationale: Validation gate for required fields; ensures nothing is submitted with missing data.

scenarios.title: Whitespace-only name is rejected
expectedResults: Error 'Enter your name' is shown under 'Name'
No error is shown for 'Email'
Form remains visible; no confirmation is shown
scenarios.rationale: Boundary of the name rule: a name consisting only of spaces is not a real name.

scenarios.title: Malformed email addresses are rejected, minimal valid address accepted
steps: Replace 'Email' with 'a b@c.d' and click 'Send message'
expectedResults: For 'not-an-email', 'a@b' and 'a b@c.d' the error 'Enter a valid email address' is shown under 'Email' (custom message, no native browser validation bubble), no error under 'Name', and the form stays visible
The previous email error is not shown once a valid address is submitted
For 'a@b.c' the form is submitted and h1 'Message sent' with 'Thanks Ada Lovelace, we reply within two working days.' is shown
scenarios.rationale: Covers email validation boundaries and the custom (non-native) error handling.

scenarios.title: Message is optional and the confirmation greets the trimmed name
steps: Fill 'Name' with '  Ada Lovelace  ' (leading and trailing spaces)
expectedResults: No validation error is shown for the empty 'Message'
h1 'Message sent' is shown
Text reads exactly 'Thanks Ada Lovelace, we reply within two working days.' without extra spaces around the name
scenarios.rationale: Business rules: message is optional; name is trimmed in the confirmation.

scenarios.title: Sending state disables the button and prevents double submit
steps: Try to click the button again while it is in the sending state
Wait for the request to finish
expectedResults: While sending, the button label reads 'Sending…' and the button is disabled with a visibly dimmed appearance
The second click does not trigger another submission
After completion h1 changes to 'Message sent' and the form is removed
The confirmation appears once only
scenarios.rationale: Loading state; protects against duplicate messages and verifies visible feedback.

scenarios.title: Form is accessible by keyboard and errors are correctable and announced
steps: Press Tab from the page start until the 'Name' field is focused (labels 'Name', 'Email', 'Message' must each be associated with their control)
Press Enter to submit while focus is in 'Email'
Fill 'Name' with 'Ada Lovelace' and correct 'Email' to 'ada@example.com'
Tab to 'Send message' and press Enter
expectedResults: Clicking each label focuses its own field (Name, Email, Message)
Pressing Enter in a field submits the form and shows 'Enter your name' and 'Enter a valid email address'
Error messages are exposed to assistive technology (e.g. role='alert' or referenced via aria-describedby) and fields carry aria-invalid=true
After correcting the values, errors disappear and submitting via keyboard shows h1 'Message sent'
scenarios.rationale: Accessibility and recovery from errors; the page model notes there is no role='alert' on error messages and errors are not cleared while typing.

scenarios.title: 'Send message' button and inputs match Figma Button/Input specs
steps: Locate the primary button 'Send message' in form 'Contact'
Inspect computed styles of the button
Inspect computed height of the 'Name' and 'Email' inputs
expectedResults: 'Send message' has background #2563EB, text colour #FFFFFF, border-radius 8px, height 44px, horizontal padding 20px, Inter 16px / weight 600 / line-height 24px
'Name' and 'Email' inputs are 44px high (size/control-height)
scenarios.rationale: The Figma Primary button is #2563EB with 8px radius; source styles use #7c3aed and a 2px radius for .btn-primary, so this should catch the deviation.

scenarios.title: Contact form is usable at mobile width without horizontal overflow
steps: Verify h1 'Contact us' and the form fields are visible
Check the document for horizontal scrolling
Submit the empty form with 'Send message'
expectedResults: No horizontal scrollbar; page width equals viewport width (390px)
Labels and fields are stacked vertically with a page gutter of 24px, and fields fit within the viewport
Inline errors 'Enter your name' and 'Enter a valid email address' are fully visible without clipping
'Send message' is at least 44px high and tappable
Confirmation 'Message sent' / 'Thanks Ada Lovelace, we reply within two working days.' is fully visible and wraps without overflow
scenarios.rationale: Form stacking and error/confirmation rendering on small screens; Figma mobile uses a 390px frame with 24px gutters.

scenarios.title: Header navigation collapses to a menu button on mobile
steps: Check for horizontal overflow of the header/page
Verify links 'Home', 'Shop all products', 'Checkout', 'Sign in to your account', 'Contact'
expectedResults: Per the Figma mobile frame, the 'Main' navigation links are hidden and a 40x40 'Open menu' button is at the right with a 24px gutter
Logo 'Demo Shop' and the menu button fit in the 64px-high header without horizontal overflow or wrapped/overlapping text
Tapping 'Open menu' reveals all nav links, including 'Contact', and its aria-expanded becomes true
scenarios.rationale: Figma mobile shows the menu button at 390px, while the source only collapses the nav at max-width 320px, so the full nav may overflow at 390px.
